video_url.description: The original video URL or identifier.

design_audit.description: Thinking Step. Format: 'DRAFT: [Timestamp Range] -> [Verbatim Clue] -> [3 Distractor Traps (False Claim / Wrong Segment / Misinterpreted Context)]'. Must match CEFR {cefr_level}.

question.description: The comprehension question (match {cefr_level}) based on what is spoken in the video segment.

options.description: Exactly 4 options containing the correct answer and 3 planned distractors. Return ONLY the literal phrase without labels or surrounding quotes (" ").

timestamp.description: The starting timestamp of the video segment where the clue/answer is discussed (e.g. '01:25' or '10:45'). Must exist verbatim in the transcript.

explanation.description: Detailed explanation of the correct answer referencing the video dialogue and why distractors do not match.

questions.description: List of {count} timestamp-aware video comprehension questions.
